source_quotes: no fabricated metrics anywhere: token counts, presence, claims are real captured values or explicitly absent
overlap_check: Built-in method_33 (verify the artifact not the status) and method_20 (cross-agent verification) cover verifying claims; drafts 13 and 16 cover verification and review. This adds the level-of-work vocabulary, count provenance and additive records. Overlap is real: at review fold into method_33 as an update.
evidence: AGENTS.md (house rules: CHECKLIST additive, no fabricated metrics)

payload.name: Report Work at the Level It Was Actually Done
payload.description: Every claim of progress says how far it went: edited, parse-checked, compiled, tested, run or deployed. Counts say how they were made, other agents' reports are checked, and records are added to, not rewritten.

principles.name: No fabricated metrics
principles.description: Every number is a captured value or is explicitly absent.

principles.name: A claim ages
principles.description: A claim true when made can be false when read; the cheap re-check beats building on it.

heuristics.condition: a fork or another agent says it is done
heuristics.action: spot-check the real artifact before relying on it

heuristics.condition: an earlier statement turns out wrong
heuristics.action: write a separate correction and leave the first as the record

decision_rules.name: Name the level
decision_rules.outcome: state each claim at its real level: edited, parse-checked, compiled, tested, run or deployed; parse-only is not verified

decision_rules.name: Say how a count was made
decision_rules.outcome: say whether it came from a static count or a run; only a real run gives passing totals

decision_rules.name: Other agents' reports are not evidence
decision_rules.condition: a fork or agent reports completion
decision_rules.outcome: verify against the real artifact; when the harness refuses a fork-written report, the parent writes it from the returned text and says so

decision_rules.name: End with what to check first
decision_rules.condition: work was never compiled or run
decision_rules.outcome: list the unverified items and the first places to look when it is built

decision_rules.name: Add, never rewrite
decision_rules.condition: a checklist or status record is updated
decision_rules.outcome: append new lines; dated history stays as the record; stale cross-references are marked, not erased
